```bash
item_id="$("$GH" project item-list "$proj" --owner "$owner" --limit 200 --format json 2>/dev/null \
    | "$JQ" -r --argjson n "$issue" '.items[] | select(.content.number==$n) | .id // empty' | head -1)"
```

Two repos with the same issue # on the same board (e.g. `dstrader-aws#9` + `FamilyFund-archive#9`) → wrong item gets the status edit (and silently the "wrong" claim/release status moves). It also caps at `--limit 200` (you have more than 200 items on board #1).

Fix would be: filter by `.content.url` (encodes repo+number) and bump the limit, in both `cmd_set_status` and any other spot that resolves item-id. Want me to patch the script?
